title: Origin story: Lugh
description: Lugh came to Tara demanding entry to the king's hall, and was refused until he asked what they lacked — a man skilled in ALL arts at once. Samildanach, the equally-skilled, he led the Tuatha De Danann against the Fomorians and slew his own grandfather Balor with a sling-stone through the evil eye.

title: Ability profile: Lugh
description: Ranked abilities: All crafts — rank 100/100; Sling combat — rank 99/100; Brilliance — rank 98/100; Strategy — rank 96/100; Kingship — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Lugh
description: Powers: Mastery of every skill simultaneously; The sling-stone that slew a god; The sun's radiance as his sign.

title: Stamina feats: Lugh
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Prepared thirteen years for the second battle of Moytura; Fought Balor though the eye slew all who met it.

title: Crossover notes: Lugh
description: Lugh crosses naturally with: mastery, kingship, craft, the sun.

title: Cultural impact: Lugh
description: Lughnasadh honors him; mastery itself as divinity.

title: Generator record: Lugh
description: This record documents the boundless generator for Lugh's database.
